title: Store
description: Store holds the options for a given Store.

defaultCertificate.description: DefaultCertificate defines the default certificate configuration.

defaultGeneratedCert.description: DefaultGeneratedCert defines the default generated certificate configuration.

domain.description: Domain is the domain definition for the DefaultCertificate.

main.description: Main defines the main domain name.

sans.description: SANs defines the subject alternative domain names.

resolver.description: Resolver is the name of the resolver that will be used to issue the DefaultCertificate.
